description_en: Queries the list of SaaS domain names under a site, including the ID, status, and domain name verification information of each SaaS domain name. You can filter results by SaaS domain name, site ID, or associated record ID
description_zh: 查询站点下的 SaaS 域名列表，包括 SaaS 域名的 ID、状态、域名验证信息等。支持根据 SaaS 域名的名称、站点 ID、绑定的记录 ID 等条件过滤
name: ListCustomHostnames

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点 ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The associated record ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850265.html operation to obtain the record ID
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的记录 ID，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850265.html获取
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.help_en:
The search match mode for the SaaS domain name. Default value: exact. Valid values:
prefix: prefix match.
suffix: suffix match.
exact: exact match.
fuzzy: fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh:
SaaS域名的搜索匹配模式。默认为精确匹配。
prefix：前缀匹配。
suffix：后缀匹配。
exact：精确匹配。
fuzzy：模糊匹配
parameters.name: name_match_type

parameters.help_en:
The SaaS domain name status. Valid values:
pending: pending verification.
active: activated.
conflicted: occupied.
offline: offline
parameters.help_zh:
SaaS 域名状态。
pending: 待验证。
active: 已激活。
conflicted: 被占用。
offline: 已下线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，第几页，取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size
